title: Show only current memory versions in ordinary agent reads and recovery
outcome: Ordinary memory reads and recovery expose only each key's current version; historical versions and links appear only after an explicit history request.
acceptance: A current full memory read does not suggest an older revision, and a revise receipt does not automatically link the replaced revision; historical links require an explicit history request
Recovery and next coalesce memory changes to the current head per key, so a cursor spanning several revisions never presents older versions as current guidance
Explicit historical revision reads remain available, and an imported memory chain leaves the latest admitted revision as the only ordinary head, including after restart
